entities.summary: First Republic, a political institution in Spain during Peninsular War & Loss of Empire (1814–1874). Grew from Cortes of Cádiz promulgate liberal constitution and Wellington. Led to the emergence of Carlist Wars & Political Instability and Spanish-American War & 'El Desastre' (1898).
